stem:
A researcher records the time, $T$ seconds, taken by adults to complete a questionnaire.

The results for a random sample of 60 adults who completed the questionnaire this year are summarised as follows.

$$n = 60 \qquad \Sigma t = 3678 \qquad \Sigma t^2 = 226\,313.36$$

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find an unbiased estimate of $\text{E}(T)$, and show that an unbiased estimate of $\text{Var}(T)$ is 14.44.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: In the past, the population mean time was 62.4 seconds.
parts.text: Test at the 2% significance level whether the population mean time for this year is less than 62.4 seconds.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: State, with a reason, whether it was necessary to use the Central Limit Theorem in your answer to part **(b)**.
